_head_at_build_time_note: The commit HEAD pointed at when the build ran (the parent of the commit that will contain this manifest). A manifest cannot pin the SHA of its own containing commit (self-reference); the runtime gate instead enforces that HEAD:<git_path> blob == committed_blob_sha256 for EVERY artifact — proving the running commit contains exactly the sanctioned bytes, which is content-addressed and stronger than a commit label.
